nom: Caudalie Premier Cru Anti-Aging Cream Moisturizer, Refillable Jar - 50 mL

avis.texte: Was looking for a luxury moisturizing cream and tried Caudalie Premier Cru as a result. I should say that I am truly impressed with the product! It provides rich texture and hydrates my skin without any greasy residue. It absorbs quickly, leaving a soft and radiant finish with a mild scent. Definitely recommend this product!

avis.titre: Great Grapes! Good for Sensitive Skin. Pleasant scent.
avis.texte: While it didn’t make me loose 10 years in 10 days, it didn’t cause any rashes, residue or unusual reactions- which is good for someone like me who has sensitive skin. Scent is pleasant too. It’s made of French grapes so every time I use it I think of a winery in France. Fancy.

I truly adore this cream. It does exactly what it claims and more. From the first application, my skin feels deeply nourished, smooth, and comforted. The texture is rich yet melts beautifully into the skin without feeling heavy, making it perfect for both morning and night. Over time, my skin looks healthier, more plump, and well-hydrated, with a softness that lasts all day. It really helps support the skin barrier and gives my skin a more youthful, refreshed glow. This is a luxurious moisturizer that truly delivers and has become a staple in my skincare routine.

avis.titre: Makes my skin feel amazing! Luxurious skincare cream!
avis.texte: This is my first time trying out anything by this particular brand, and I am absolutely amazed by this 'Caudalie' Premier Cru moisturizing cream! I love that the cream came in a nice glass jar, which can be refilled; the fact that the jar can be reused has a lot of importance to me. The cream was sealed by foil upon arrival, which I always appreciate-especially when trying something new. The texture of this cream is divine; it feels so smooth going on my skin, and only takes a small amount. After applying to my skin, my face feels soft, supple, and highly moisturized. I love what I've seen thus far, as I've been using for a few days now (both in the morning and at night). My skin feels so nice, and also appears more youthful and bright. I can't wait to see what the more longer-term results will look like! This is a premium skincare brand, and an exceptionally great moisturizer! It's very gentle on my skin, and doesn't feel heavy nor greasy; additionally, it works well with my other skincare products and underneath makeup too. I like the light fragrance to it; it's very light, and smells sort of like fruit (grape). Very refreshing! I'm very satisfied with this product, and would love to try out more products from 'Caudalie'. I think that the value for money is good in this particular product, even though it is a bit more pricier than other moisturizers I've used. Upfront this anti aging cream is expensive, but I was very happy with the results. The cream is easy to apply and goes on evenly. The cream absorbs very well, and did not cause any irritation. There was a mild scent, but nothing overpowering. I was pretty amazed with the results and effectiveness of this cream. My skin was super soft and hydrated, and looked amazing. A little bit of this cream went along way, I will definitely continue to use.

I am impressed with this Premier Cru Anti-Aging Cream from Caudalie. The first thing I noticed was the luxurious packaging. It comes in the glass refillable jar. The cream has a rich texture but absorbs beautifully. It leaves my skin feeling deeply hydrated and smooth. I’ve been using it morning and night as directed. My skin looks plumper, and the fine lines around my eyes and forehead are less noticeable. I am satisfied with the results and the eco-friendly packaging, and would recommend this product for others.
This cream is really hydrating. I have dry skin and this works well. I would say it’s high quality. The price point is fair for the quality of the product. I would buy this again.
